texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (6)  Landscaping, fencing, berming and visual screening shall be compatible with adjacent land uses and shall be as required by the Municipal Planning Commission through the consideration of a Development Permit for any development on the site.
texts.text: Landscaping, fencing, berming and visual screening shall be compatible with adjacent land uses and shall be as required by the Municipal Planning Commission through the consideration of a Development Permit for any development on the site.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (7)  All applications for Development Permits in Noise Exposure Forecast (NEF) areas over 25 shall be referred to the Regional Office of the Ministry of Transport, Edmonton, and comments shall be received prior to a decision being made.
texts.text: All applications for Development Permits in Noise Exposure Forecast (NEF) areas over 25 shall be referred to the Regional Office of the Ministry of Transport, Edmonton, and comments shall be received prior to a decision being made.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (8)  Construction of buildings at a location where the NEF is 25 or greater shall be in accordance with Part 11 of the Alberta Building Code.
texts.text: Construction of buildings at a location where the NEF is 25 or greater shall be in accordance with Part 11 of the Alberta Building Code.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (9)  Should the Helicopter Repair and Maintenance Facility cease to operate the residential use of the land shall also cease within three (3) months thereof.
texts.text: Should the Helicopter Repair and Maintenance Facility cease to operate the residential use of the land shall also cease within three (3) months thereof.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (10)  That the occupants of the residence shall be involved in the operation of the Helicopter Repair and Maintenance Facility.
texts.text: That the occupants of the residence shall be involved in the operation of the Helicopter Repair and Maintenance Facility.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: (11)  The location and appearance of buildings and structures shall be to the satisfaction of the Municipal Planning Commission as a consideration of any Development Permit issued for the site.
texts.text: The location and appearance of buildings and structures shall be to the satisfaction of the Municipal Planning Commission as a consideration of any Development Permit issued for the site.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: (12)  Unless otherwise defined in this Direct Control Bylaw, all words and uses shall be defined as per Part One (Definitions) of the City of Airdrie Land Use Bylaw, as amended.
texts.text: (12)  Unless otherwise defined in this Direct Control Bylaw, all words and uses shall be defined as per Part One (Definitions) of the City of Airdrie Land Use Bylaw, as amended.

texts.orig: Helicopter Repair and Maintenance Facility means:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A development used for the servicing, washing and repairing of helicopters and other incidental related operations  and  supporting  uses.  This  does  not  include  other  large-scale  operations  that  would  be permitted under the general "Airport Operations" land use.
